text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And then came the Arima Kinen. A massive 
crowd had packed into Nakayama 
Racecourse."

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
If I remember right, Hishi Amazon and 
Narita Brian ran in the Arima Kinen last 
year too, didn't they?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Our positions are totally reversed now 
compared to back then, huh? I mean, Hishi 
Amazon's been incredible lately...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian still hasn't gotten back into 
shape, right? I really hope she does her 
best today...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While a buzz of varied chatter filled the 
stands, down in the underground passage—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
This day has finally come...! Right, 
Brian!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It's a one-on-one showdown between "Narita 
Brian" and "Hishi Amazon"—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I have no intention of giving it up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian firmly shook the right hand 
Hishi Amazon offered her.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. Now that's a good look on your 
face.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Now then—Trainy! Just sit back, relax, and 
leave everything to me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
The culmination of everything we've worked 
for! I'll make sure I'm in tip-top shape!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The curtain finally rises on the Arima 
Kinen, amidst a swirl of anticipation and 
anxiety...!
